graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
NOVEL CONSTRUCTION (Q-Lead-designed; NOT a standard factor-zoo entry, confirmed ABSENT from factor_registry.json's 373 factors). Relational/structural by design -- deliberately leaving the single-name PRICE-PATH-SHAPE family that has now FAILED twice in KR (frog-in-the-pan WT-D20260529_002, Hurst WT-D20260621_001). Per measurement-graduation S6, KR long-only is beta~0.99 with cross-sleeve gross corr ~0.78 dominated by the market PC1 plus strong sector/chaebol co-movement; return-momentum in a long-only top-25 book inherits that common beta as noise.

CONCEPT: For each stock i, learn its DYNAMIC co-movement PEER GROUP -- the set of names it has historically co-moved with most (rolling return-correlation KNN, or reuse regime_factor_clusters). Form the DEFECTION series d_i,t = r_i,t - mean(r_peers(i),t) (return in excess of the stock's own learned peer cluster). The signal = momentum of the defection series (12-1 with 1m skip), optionally gated by defection persistence/breadth (sustained defection across recent months, not a one-off jump). Thesis: a stock that 'defects' from -- and SUSTAINS outperformance over -- its own co-movement partners is undergoing genuine idiosyncratic re-rating that has escaped cluster beta; return-momentum drowns this in market drift, defection-momentum isolates it.

DISTINCT FROM existing factors (must be PROVEN orthogonal & additive, not a relabel): M08_ResidMom residualizes vs the MARKET (CAPM) -- PCDM residualizes vs a LEARNED PEER MANIFOLD, stripping far more common variation in KR. M24_Sector_Relative uses STATIC GICS sector -- PCDM uses a DYNAMIC learned co-movement cluster (correlation neighbors, not industry labels). Target |corr| < 0.6 vs {M01, M08, M24} and incremental IC; if it collapses to M08/M24, report and stop.

CONSTRUCTION (alpha-research chooses & A/B tests autonomously): peer-group = rolling-corr top-K neighbors (test K in {10,20,40}, window {252,504}) OR regime_factor_clusters communities; defection horizon = 12-1 (also test 6-1); gating = defection persistence (fraction of recent months d>0) and/or breadth. Robustness to K/window is mandatory (peer-learning adds estimation noise). Also test the reversal trap: confirm defection-momentum continues rather than mean-reverts.

EXPECTED_ROLE: core / offensive momentum alpha that is inherently more market- and cluster-neutral (the defection differences out market drift and peer-cluster beta). Aims to surface the idiosyncratic re-rating component that long-only return-momentum cannot isolate -- targeting the realized portfolio-alpha ceiling rather than adding another beta-laden momentum variant.

WHY_NOW: (1) PG0 gap vector sleeve_needs=core_alpha, target SR 2.5 / CAGR 16 / MDD 25, regime NEUTRAL. (2) KR structural finding (measurement-graduation S6): long-only beta~0.99, market PC1 explains ~0.76 of variance, sector/chaebol co-movement strong -- so return-momentum's signal is buried under common beta; PCDM differences the peer cluster out at the source. (3) Single-name path-shape momentum has now failed twice in KR (FIP, Hurst); the surviving door is relational/structural, which this is.

PIT / CONSTRAINTS: peer clusters learned from returns with Date<=sig_date ONLY (C1 rolling/expanding, NO full-sample correlation; C2 no same-day). Z_Score_Aligned (C13). Compute from rawdata returns via the compute_momentum.R pattern; reuse load_month_factors for the orthogonality comparison (C15). Long-only ONLY (KR no-short mandate). Universe KOSPI200 u KOSDAQ150, 2005-01-01 onward, max 25 names, weight bounds [0,0.20], 15bps delta cost, production liquidity 2e8 ADTV for the deployable top-N screen.

HONEST RISK (AX-000 / AX-007): AX-007 applies -- a single-sleeve long-only top-25 may break the cross-sectional-signal -> portfolio-alpha translation even with strong rank-IC. Graduation is NOT presumed; a real-but-non-graduating signal routes to screening-tier (OVERLAY_CANDIDATE / FR_RCMA / DPL_FEATURE) per measurement-graduation 2-tier. Additional risks: peer-cluster estimation noise (K/window sensitivity -- must show robustness), and defection possibly being a slow-reversal trap (must test continuation vs reversal). Measurement is real-computation only (canonical_screen_bt / build_bt_result); proxy hand-calc graduation forbidden.
